findings.title: x
findings.message: The typeface callback is bound to the family captured at View time. When the owner calls View again after accepting, it gets new closures. But a stale family-change event arriving after another family change uses the old p.Value (read at event time), which is fine. However the faceCombo guard `p.Value.FamilyID != family.ID` silently drops events while the family combo in the same render stays enabled, so quick successive edits are lost without feedback.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable if intended; otherwise surface an Invalid/refresh signal for dropped obsolete events.

finding.title: Expensive availability check repeated
finding.message: available() runs reflect.DeepEqual plus a full validate() (map allocations) on every callback and on every Disabled computation (3 times per View), making each View O(catalog) with repeated allocations; with up to MaxMenuOptions families and faces this is wasteful.
finding.suggestion: Compute the disabled flag once in View and reuse it; keep the full check only in callbacks.
